scientific_question: After analytically removing ambient QR and TT-bond gauge redundancy, can the true horizontal tangent of the identical fitted rank-150 TT express and stably transfer the remaining routed-function residual?

causal_reconciliation.observed_numerics: Ambient QR-coordinate J^T J has exact or near-zero diagonal entries, 1e17-1e28 dynamic range, and 16-step diagonal-PCG residual 0.464-0.771. The incomplete coupled solve improves recovery but cannot adjudicate the tangent under the frozen residual gate.
causal_reconciliation.geometric_cause: For each left-canonical nonterminal TT unfolding Q in R^(m x r), ambient perturbations contain redundant vertical/bond-gauge directions. The standard fixed-rank TT horizontal gauge imposes Q^T delta_Q = 0; write delta_Q = Q_perp K and place bond motion in the following core.
causal_reconciliation.why_this_is_not_retuning: Ranks, modes, endpoint functions, functional targets, activation banks, damping ratio, Hutchinson count, PCG iterations, and every scientific gate are unchanged. Only analytically null/redundant optimizer coordinates are removed.
causal_reconciliation.scope: This remains a zero-update local tangent audit. It does not fit TT cores, alter checkpoints, add a dense basis, or authorize language-model training.

horizontal_parameterization.base: Use each saved fitted canonical core exactly. For every nonterminal core reshape to Q in R^(m x r), compute a deterministic complete-QR complement Q_perp, and expose K in R^((m-r) x r) through delta_Q = Q_perp K. Expose the final amplitude core directly.
horizontal_parameterization.gauge_condition: Q^T delta_Q = 0 for every nonterminal core

metric_protocol.functional_feature: Identical to the parent audit: equal-expert normalized dense-c_proj residual output plus 0.25 normalized pre-GELU residual, averaged across layers by feature scaling.
metric_protocol.jacobian: Exact torch.func JVP/VJP at K=0 and zero final-core displacement through the multilinear TT contraction, GELU, and fixed dense expert c_proj.
metric_protocol.precision: float32 CUDA with float64 scalar reductions where practical

evaluation.direction_fit: At each of the two saved fitted endpoint functions, derive separate horizontal directions from discovery_a and discovery_b; no joint or selected direction.
evaluation.direction_scoring: Score exact JVP images on source discovery, opposite discovery, and both untouched heldout banks.
scale_free_metrics: unchanged source-selected scalar recovery on transfer
evaluation.controls: The ambient parent and horizontal audit use the same endpoint functions, residuals, banks, metric, damping ratio, estimator count, PCG iterations, and gates.

decision_rule.simple_metric_pass: All gates plus diagonal/full fraction pass: authorize only one separately preregistered offline horizontal-diagonal functional refit.
decision_rule.coupled_metric_pass: All absolute, gain, transfer, stability, convergence, and finiteness gates pass but diagonal/full fraction fails: authorize only one separately preregistered offline horizontal Gauss-Newton refit.
decision_rule.local_tangent_fail: PCG converges but horizontal Gauss-Newton source recovery is below 0.5: reject optimizer preconditioning as sufficient at these fitted endpoints and close local optimization of this exact TT family.
decision_rule.generalization_fail: Source passes but heldout, gain, transfer, or stability fails: reject the direction as activation- or endpoint-specific and do not refit.
decision_rule.solver_fail: PCG again misses 0.1 after analytic gauge removal: the audit remains numerically inconclusive. Do not change damping, iterations, estimator count, or gates; record that this exact function metric is not practically solvable under the registered method.

systems.preflight: Run one seed/source with two PCG iterations and one Hutchinson probe; project full runtime from measured exact-JVP/VJP operation counts.
systems.monitoring: Foreground-poll only if projected runtime is below five minutes; otherwise install one terminal/error-only @Codex watchdog.
